items.source:
We want a shallow copy in this case: We want to use the same interceptor
chain and other object references, but we want an independent value for the
current interceptor index.
items.translation: 在这种情况下，我们想要一个浅拷贝：我们希望使用相同的拦截器链和其他对象引用，但需要一个独立的当前拦截器索引值。

items.source: It is possible to clone an invocation, to invoke proceed() repeatedly (once per clone), using the invocableClone() method. It is also possible to attach custom attributes to the invocation, using the setUserAttribute(String, Object) / getUserAttribute(String) methods.
items.translation: 可以克隆一个调用，使用invocableClone()方法重复地（每个克隆一次）调用proceed()。还可以使用setUserAttribute(String, Object) / getUserAttribute(String)方法将自定义属性附加到调用上。

items.source: NOTE: This class is considered internal and should not be directly accessed. The sole reason for it being public is compatibility with existing framework integrations (for example, Pitchfork). For any other purposes, use the ProxyMethodInvocation interface instead.
items.translation: 注意： 此类被视为内部实现，不应直接访问。其公开的唯一原因是为了与现有的框架集成（例如 Pitchfork）保持兼容。对于其他用途，请使用 ProxyMethodInvocation 接口。

items.source: Invokes the target object using reflection. Subclasses can override the invokeJoinpoint() method to change this behavior, so this is also a useful base class for more specialized MethodInvocation implementations.
items.translation: 使用反射调用目标对象。子类可以重写invokeJoinpoint()方法来更改此行为，因此这也是实现更专门的 MethodInvocation 的有用基类。

items.source: interceptorsAndDynamicMethodMatchers - interceptors that should be applied, along with any InterceptorAndDynamicMethodMatchers that need evaluation at runtime. MethodMatchers included in this struct must already have been found to have matched as far as was possibly statically. Passing an array might be about 10% faster, but would complicate the code. And it would work only for static pointcuts.
items.translation: `interceptorsAndDynamicMethodMatchers` - 应应用的拦截器，以及需要在运行时评估的 InterceptorAndDynamicMethodMatchers。此结构中包含的 MethodMatchers 必须已经尽可能在静态阶段被确定为匹配。传递数组可能会快约 10%，但会使代码复杂化，并且仅适用于静态切点。
